03 / BEHIND THE STUDIO

One curiosity.
Many expressions.

Hi, I’m Steven.
This is my personal studio, and an ever-evolving space for creative work.

My background spans painting and piano. Through photography, print, model making, objects and installations, I explore how ideas take shape in different materials.
